rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for acquiring a skill, studying a subject, or taking up a course.

example.english: I want to learn to cook.

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is becoming informed or finding out a fact, rather than acquiring a skill.

example.english: I learn from the news that they moved house.
example.traditional: 我睇新聞先知道佢哋搬咗屋。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tai2 san1 man4 sin1 zi1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 bun1 zo2 uk1

rows.note: Use this formal phrase specifically for learning a lesson from a bad experience or mistake.

example.english: The company should learn a lesson from this accident.
example.traditional: 公司應該從今次事故吸取教訓。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 jing1 goi1 cung4 gam1 ci3 si6 gu3 kap1 ceoi2 gaau3 fan3
